key.name: default-view
key.summary: View for folders opened for the first time

key.name: row-size
key.summary: Size of cards and list rows

key.name: color-scheme
key.summary: Light, dark, or follow the system

key.name: accent
key.summary: The colour: aubergine (matches the icon), the system accent, or one of the app's other colours

key.name: downloads-folder
key.description: Empty means the system's Downloads folder.

key.name: index-exclude
key.summary: Folders the search index leaves out

key.name: welcome-shown
key.description: Set when the first-run welcome is finished or skipped (P6-T01).

key.name: last-version
key.description: What's New shows once when the app runs a newer version than this (P6-T02).

key.name: default-file-manager
key.summary: Use Steward as the default file manager
key.description: Open folders in Steward and answer other apps' "Show in folder" (org.freedesktop.FileManager1) while Steward runs (P6-T07).

key.name: open-in-terminal
key.summary: The terminal for Open in Terminal (F4)
key.description: An Open In id ("gnome-terminal", "kitty"…), "custom" for open-in-terminal-command, or empty for the system's default (P7-T02).

key.name: open-in-terminal-command
key.summary: Your own terminal command; {} is the folder

key.name: open-in-editor
key.summary: The editor for Open in Editor (Shift+F4)
key.description: An Open In id ("vscode", "zed"…), "custom", or empty for the first editor found.

key.name: open-in-editor-command
key.summary: Your own editor command; {} is the folder

key.name: shelf-shortcut-enabled
key.summary: Open the Shelf with a key from any app
key.description: Written to GNOME as a custom keyboard shortcut that runs “steward shelf”, and removed when turned off.

key.name: shelf-shortcut
key.summary: The key that opens the Shelf (Qt key-sequence syntax)

key.name: tray-icon
key.summary: Show an icon in the top bar that opens the Shelf

key.name: open-at-login
key.summary: Start in the background at login, for the Shelf and tray icon

key.name: shortcuts
key.description: Action (with its parameter, e.g. win.view-mode('list')) to keys; an empty list means no shortcut. Others keep their built-in keys.

key.name: search-contents
key.summary: Search also finds words inside files

key.name: content-folders
key.summary: Folders outside Home whose files' text is read for search
key.description: Search inside files reads Home only, unless folders are added here.

key.name: bookmark-fetch
key.summary: Fetch a saved link's title and picture
key.description: Contacts the link's own site when a bookmark is added. It is the only request the app makes.

key.name: bookmark-view
key.summary: How bookmarks are shown: grid, list, headlines or masonry
